**Company Overview**
--------------------

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

  

**Department Overview**
-----------------------

Silvus Technologies, a leading provider of advanced MANET and MIMO communications systems, is reshaping mesh network technology for mission-critical applications – on the ground, in the air and at sea. Its battle-proven StreamCaster family of MANET radios and proprietary MN-MIMO waveform provides the vital communications link for defense, law enforcement and public safety agencies around the world, and in the toughest operational environments.
  
  
Silvus Technologies is a wholly owned subsidiary of Motorola Solutions, Inc.
  
  
Would you like to join an incredibly talented group of people, doing very challenging work, with the prime directive of “Keeping Our Heroes Connected”?

**Job Description**
-------------------

THE OPPORTUNITY

  

Silvus is seeking an ***Embedded Software Engineer*** who will participate in the development of Silvus’ MANET radios and advanced research projects. This position reports to the *Director of Software Engineering* on the Software Engineering team.

  

This position is on a hybrid schedule, a minimum of 3 days onsite per week is expected. On-site days are Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. The location for this role is Silvus Technologies’ headquarters in the heart of vibrant ***West Los Angeles, CA*** .

  

The following is a list of at least some of the current essential job functions of the position. Management may assign or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time at its discretion.

  

ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES

* Implement software portion of MAC (Medium Access Control) and routing protocols.
* Analyze and improve product security and robustness to meet certain regulatory requirements such as NIST FIPS 140-3 and Common Criteria.
* Implement network management software and web interface.
* Application and user interface development for customer demonstrations and evaluations.
* Implement testing software and product performance and reliability testing.
* Linux system customization and scripting.
* Implement different security protocols and encryption algorithms.
* *Travel requirement; rare local travel, as required by Silvus.*
  

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

* Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or Computer Engineering.
* Demonstrated expertise in C programming.
* **NOTE - Must be a U.S. Person (U.S. permanent resident or U.S. citizen) due to U.S. government contracts.**
* **All employment is contingent upon the successful clearance of a background check and drug test**

  

PREFERRED KNOWLEDGE SKILLS AND ABILITIES

* Exposure to embedded system software development.
* Familiarity with Linux kernel driver development.
  

COMPENSATION: $38.46 - $52.88/hourly

At Raytheon, the foundation of everything we do is rooted in our values and a higher calling – to help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression. We bring the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. Our team solves tough, meaningful problems that create a safer, more secure world.

Sensors: Space and Air division in El Segundo, CA is seeking a **Senior Software Engineer [Embedded / Radar]** to be part of their product development teams for the Airborne Radar Systems group to work one or more of the following key areas:

* DevOps Support
* Software Build Manager
* Air-to-Air Radar Software Engineer
* Air-to-Ground Radar Software Engineer

Visit Raytheon Landing Page: Raytheon El Segundo, CA Location

What you will do:

The Gen 4 Airborne Radar Department mission is to provide world class Software for our customers’ wide array of RF products for airborne radar applications. Our software capabilities include software requirement development, design, modeling/simulation, real-time embedded, signal processing and data processing, infrastructure software, software testing, integration, and verification. Gen 4 Airborne Radar SW team in El Segundo CA is looking to add a Software Engineer to their F/A-18 development team.

  

* Design, develop, and test software based on software trouble reports in an agile/waterfall, collaborative environment, delivering builds for the APG-79 radar.
* Support system integration of software on hardware
* Support Development and Production software development for F/A-18 Next-Gen roadmap activities
* Demonstrate critical thinking skills, the ability to thrive in small, empowered teams, and an intense desire to directly enable our customers’ success
* Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize existing code for performance and efficiency in complex environments
* Write and maintain comprehensive documentation for software applications, including system architecture and design specifications
* Participate in program execution and continuous improvement
* Work collaboratively with multiple engineering disciplines to analyze, implement, and test system modification requests to the existing system baseline
* Work Location: Onsite at our El Segundo, CA Campus
* **Must be able to obtain "special access programs" (SAP/SAR) for continuation of employment.**

Qualifications you must have:

* Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and 5 years of relevant software experience.
* Development experience coding in C, C++, ADA or related languages/tools across phases of SDLC.
* Experience working on UNIX, Linux, Windows, VxWorks, Green Hills or other RTOS.
* Active and transferable U.S. Government issued **Secret security** clearance is required prior to start date. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance.

Qualifications We Prefer:

* Current Top Secret Clearance
* Ability to work with minimal supervision and collaborate on small teams
* Development experience in Ground or Airborne Sensors (Radars, EO/IR, EW, etc.)
* Experience designing & implementing radar modes & algorithms, signal processing, target detection, and tracking
* Experience with Networks (software and hardware)
* Experience developing near-real-time, embedded SW
* Experience with git
* Experience with embedded or low-level software development, including OS-adjacent or hardware-interfacing work.
* Experience with CI/CD tools and infrastructure such as Jenkins, Subversion, or similar.
* Familiarity with Agile lifecycle process including Scrum, Continuous Integration, and Test-Driven Development Methodologies
* Experience with the DevOps Pipeline
* Experience managing software builds
* Experience developing Air-to-Air Radar Software
* Experience developing Air-to-Ground Radar Software
* Experience developing embedded software for sensors, algorithm development, signal or data processing preferred.
* Experience with DoD & related System/SW Architectures and messaging standards (e.g. OMS, SOSA, Link-16, etc)
* Experience with production-level SW development & deployment, including DevOps, DevSecOps, and/or Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) using modern FOSS/COTS toolsets.
* Experience with full lifecycle SW development of high-TRL systems
* Experience with HW/SW I&T and V&V of high-TRL systems

What We Offer:

Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.

jobs.title: Cobol Software Developer
jobs.description:
##### **About Peraton**

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

##### **About The Role**

Peraton is hiring a Cobol Software Developer for a remote role supporting our CMS program.

  

The Peraton Health, State and Local Sector is seeking Cobol Software Developer to join us in supporting and maintaining the Medicare Fee For Service claims processing system. In this role, you will serve as a principal technical contributor on an Agile team providing maintenance and operations support for the Medicare Durable Medical Equipment (DME) contract.

  

As a Cobol Software Developer, you will help plan, direct, and coordinate software development across multiple functional areas of the DME system. This role will operate in a highly structured, rigorous development environment, spanning high-level technical design, hands-on coding, unit testing, and defect resolution. At this level, the candidate is expected to exercise a high degree of independent judgement, serve as a technical authority within the team, and provide leadership and mentorship to developers at all levels.

  

You will design, develop, and enhance core software programs while adhering to strict coding standards. Quality is vital to this mission, this role must build and execute your own unit test plans, test cases, and test data. Additionally, the Senior Advisor role is responsible for installing changes into internal testing regions, troubleshooting and resolving defects, and keeping technical documentation current.

  

What you'll do:

  

* Designs, codes, unit tests, and debugs complex enhancements and fixes to the Medicare health claims processing system while adhering to strict coding standards.
* Leads technical design sessions and drives implementation of complex software components.
* Applies deep technical expertise to deliver reliable, high-quality maintenance and development solutions.
* Integrate technical knowledge and business understanding to implement end-user and enterprise solutions of high complexity with minimal direction.
* Serves as a principal technical contributor on a persistent Agile development team supporting maintenance and operations.
* Demonstrates advanced, practical mastery of mainframe development concepts, practices, and engineering techniques.
* Consult with team members, cross-functional organizations, clients, and vendors to resolve complex technical issues.
* Serves as a mentor and technical resource to developers, actively supporting team growth and knowledge transfer.
* Represents the team during client-facing technical discussions, communicating complex issues clearly and effectively.
* Provide reliable time and resources estimates for your assigned tasks and projects to ensure sprint predictability.
* Troubleshoot problems independently and deliver effective, well-reasoned solutions.
* Contributes to the strategic technical direction of the development team and assists in developing solutions to complex business and technology problems.

##### **Qualifications**

What you'll need:

* Education & Experience: BS/BA degree with 12+ years of relevant experience; or Master's degree with 10 years of relevant experience; or HS diploma with 16 years of relevant experience.
* 10+ years of mainframe development experience in production or maintenance environment.
* U.S. Citizenship
* Ability to obtain Public Trust clearance
* Advanced proficiency with mainframe technologies such as COBOL, JCL, CICS, TSO and VSAM.
* Knowledge of health care claims processing, particularly Medicare Fee For Service.
* Ability to perform well in a highly rigorous, structured development environment.
* Demonstrated experience as a senior or principal software developer in a mainframe environment.
* Demonstrated ability to determine and decompose business and technical requirements.
* Application lifecycle methodology experience, specifically Agile/SCRUM.
* Strong communication skills and technical writing ability, including client-facing communication.
* Ability to develop application project solutions and provide accurate estimates.
* Experience with Medicare Part A, Medicare Part B, DME or Medicare Common Working File (CWF) specific processing systems.
* Experience working with or in support of CMS programs or contracts.
* Experience with DevOps/DevSecOps tools and frameworks through plan, define, build, test, release and deploy processes.
  

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience with Assembler language in a mainframe environment.
* Familiarity with development and collaboration tools: GitHub, Jira, Confluence, Eclipse (IDz/RDz).
* Exposure to modern languages such as Java or Python.
* SAFe experience and/or certification.

##### **Details**

**Target Salary Range:** $104,000 - $166,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.
